Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrocrackingYieldBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrocrackingYieldBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrocrackingYieldBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable screening-level hydrocracking product-yield and hydrogen-consumption balance.

The calculation converts a caller-selected fraction of a hydrocarbon feed, adds a caller-selected hydrogen consumption, and allocates the converted outlet among light gas, naphtha, and middle-distillate lumps. It is an algebraic scenario receipt, not a kinetic, reactor, catalyst, phase-equilibrium, or product-property model.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static RefineryHydrocrackingYieldBalance calculate(double feedMassFlowKgPerHour, double conversionFraction, double hydrogenConsumptionKgPerTonneFeed, double lightGasMassFractionOfConvertedProduct, double naphthaMassFractionOfConvertedProduct, double middleDistillateMassFractionOfConvertedProduct)
      Calculate a three-product-lump hydrocracking yield balance.
      Parameters:
      feedMassFlowKgPerHour - hydrocarbon feed mass flow in kg/h
      conversionFraction - fraction of hydrocarbon feed converted, in [0, 1]
      hydrogenConsumptionKgPerTonneFeed - consumed hydrogen in kg/t hydrocarbon feed
      lightGasMassFractionOfConvertedProduct - light-gas fraction of converted feed plus consumed hydrogen
      naphthaMassFractionOfConvertedProduct - naphtha fraction of converted feed plus consumed hydrogen
      middleDistillateMassFractionOfConvertedProduct - middle-distillate fraction of converted feed plus consumed hydrogen
      Returns:
      immutable hydrocracking yield receipt
